Falcon Edge Capital LP Trimmed Facebook (Call) (FB) Holding by $21.35 Million; Share Price Declined; Pathstone Family Office Has Lifted Its Amazon Com (AMZN) Position by $596,039 as Stock Value Rose
May 16, 2018 - By Maria Brooks
Richard Gerson decreased its stake in Facebook Inc (Call) (FB) by 71.23% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Falcon Edge Capital Lp sold 121,300 shares as the company’s stock declined 14.10% with the market. The hedge fund run by Richard Gerson held 49,000 shares of the technology company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $8.65 million, down from 170,300 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Falcon Edge Capital Lp who had been investing in Facebook Inc (Call) for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $531.43 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.39% or $0.73 during the last trading session, reaching $183.59. About 4.54 million shares traded. Facebook, Inc. (NASDAQ:FB) has risen 8.48% since May 16, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 3.07% the S&P500.
Pathstone Family Office Llc increased its stake in Amazon Com Inc (AMZN) by 141% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Pathstone Family Office Llc bought 509 shares as the company’s stock rose 28.13% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 870 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $1.02M, up from 361 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Pathstone Family Office Llc who had been investing in Amazon Com Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $771.07B market cap company. The stock increased 0.82% or $12.98 during the last trading session, reaching $1589.1. About 889,219 shares traded. Amazon.com, Inc. (NASDAQ:AMZN) has risen 76.78% since May 16, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 65.23% the S&P500.
Among 55 analysts covering Facebook ( NASDAQ:FB ), 51 have Buy rating, 2 Sell and 2 Hold. Therefore 93% are positive. Facebook had 269 analyst reports since July 21, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. The rating was maintained by Nomura with “Buy” on Thursday, November 5. Robert W. Baird maintained Facebook, Inc. (NASDAQ:FB) on Thursday, July 30 with “Outperform” rating. The stock of Facebook, Inc. (NASDAQ:FB) has “Buy” rating given on Thursday, November 5 by Pivotal Research. On Friday, August 11 the stock rating was maintained by Tigress Financial with “Buy”. The firm has “Outperform” rating by Wedbush given on Thursday, November 3. Bank of America maintained the shares of FB in report on Monday, July 24 with “Buy” rating. The firm has “Buy” rating given on Wednesday, January 31 by Aegis Capital. The rating was maintained by Deutsche Bank with “Buy” on Thursday, April 28. The firm earned “Outperform” rating on Thursday, January 28 by FBR Capital. Barclays Capital maintained Facebook, Inc. (NASDAQ:FB) on Thursday, April 26 with “Overweight” rating.
Analysts await Facebook, Inc. (NASDAQ:FB) to report earnings on July, 25. They expect $1.72 EPS, up 30.30% or $0.40 from last year’s $1.32 per share. FB’s profit will be $4.98B for 26.68 P/E if the $1.72 EPS becomes a reality. After $1.69 actual EPS reported by Facebook, Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 1.78% EPS growth.
